5 Painting Mistakes That Ruin Your Home Walls | Avoid These!

Hiring a painter? Make sure they don’t make these 5 common mistakes that cause peeling, bad finish & short paint life.

Top 5 Mistakes Painters Make:
1. No Surface Preparation - Skipping cleaning + sanding makes paint not stick and peel quickly
2. Cheap/Wrong Primer - Low quality primer affects both finish and paint life
3. Extra Thinning of Paint- Too much water reduces coverage + spoils smooth finish  
4. Wrong Tools - Poor brush/roller creates uneven texture + roller marks
5. Ignoring Drying Time* - Applying 2nd coat before 1st dries causes bubbles + peeling

Remember: Right preparation + Right tools + Right technique = Perfect finish & long lasting paint

featured_reviews.name: gaurav monga
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Homenhance, Mira Road, and I feel it is important to share this in detail for future customers.

1. Poor Initial Responsiveness

On our first visit, we met Ruchika and discussed our requirements in detail. We were promised a quotation within 2 working days. However, even after 3 days, there was no response. We had to repeatedly follow up before finally receiving the quotation.

This was our first red flag — lack of commitment to timelines even at the inquiry stage.

2. Delayed Communication & Lack of Professionalism

We later met the owner, Leo, who explained the quotation. We requested revisions and asked for the final version. Once again, the final quotation was sent only after multiple follow-ups.
At this stage, it already felt like we were chasing the company to give them business.

3. Complete Lack of Engagement After Confirmation

The most disappointing part began after we agreed to proceed with their quotation.

Once we confirmed, communication drastically dropped. Emails went unanswered. An appointment was scheduled for site visit but no one turned up and there was no response to our calls on that day and no confirmation. After that , despite following up for 5–6 consecutive days, we received absolutely no response.

No acknowledgment. No update. No courtesy.

4. The Final Response – A Polite Dismissal

After days of silence, another girl ( i think her name was Rashmi) responded with a carefully worded message explaining that their schedules are full and suggesting we explore other options if we need quicker turnaround.
This raises serious concerns:

Why were we not informed earlier about schedule constraints?

Why was our time wasted with meetings, discussions, and multiple quotation revisions?

Why were we ignored after showing readiness to proceed?

It appears that unless a project fits their preferred scale or budget, clients are simply deprioritized and left hanging without basic communication.

5. Core Issue: Disrespect for Client Time

What is most unacceptable is not the delay — it is the complete lack of transparency and respect for a client’s time.

If a company is not interested in a project, the professional way to handle it is to clearly communicate that upfront — not ignore emails for days and then send a diplomatic rejection.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Sir,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Since we work exclusively with our in-house team and do not outsource any labor, we set a fixed number of projects each month to ensure timely delivery and maintain quality standards—without overwhelming either our clients or our staff.

Our intention was never to waste your time. We accept projects with client satisfaction as our primary goal. However, due to the number of ongoing projects, our capacity for the month was fully occupied, and were unable to accommodate additional work.

We truly appreciate your understanding.

Thank you,
Homenhance

Title: Fantastic Painting Job - Highly Recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
PaintMaster has very professional team, who have delivered outstanding quality work within the committed time for our entire flat.

Mr Avinash has a team of very good workmen. He personally supervises the progress and quality of work on every alternate day thru personal visits.

PaintMaster's workmen cover all items properly, ensure cleaning of the area under painting every day at end of work, so there is no hastle of dust or paint marks on floor, which are properly cleaned.

We gave the entire painting contract of our flat to PaintMaster and we are very happy with overall delivery - from use of quality material used which is as per pre- agreed specifications to final delivery of the excellent quality.

We are completely satisfied and strongly recommend PaintMaster for all kind of painting work

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text: It was the second time that we appointed Avinash and his team for painting work for our home. I feel they are professional and knowledgeable and his team mates who work with him are very sincere and punctual, and he makes sure that the quality of work is not compromised and it's gets completed in the schedule time period. I highly  recommend everyone to try his service.
